name: interactioncombinators
description: Lafont's interaction combinators on a Void Maiz canvas: every gesture and every rewrite is a dispatched, logged, undoable Void Core command, and two people can reduce one net at once.

requires.name: voidmaiz
requires.note: the canvas, gestures, inspector, the reduce executor, the collaboration layer, the phone layout kit and the update client. Void Maiz in turn locates Void Core (../VoidCore) and Void Allomone (../VoidAllomone).

requires.name: voidpalabra
requires.note: sync. Present: the desktop build gains Host/Join and the two-window duo bench. Absent: the app builds solo.

platforms_note: A SHIPPING RECORD, as Void Maiz and Void Hormiga use the field: both were built and handed to a person (0.2.0, 2026-09-21; the author ran the APK on a phone). The Windows build is a portable .zip and the Android build an .apk, not the setup.exe / .tar.gz that `mago feed` names today, so tools/package_release.ps1 fills in the artifact names and hashes after Mago writes the document (asked of Void Mago 2026-09-21).

release.summary: two devices on the same Wi-Fi can work on one net: a phone and a PC, or two PCs
adds: A LAN button (on the bar at the bottom): Share this net, or Join a net someone on your Wi-Fi is sharing
The host sees who wants to join and presses Allow or Deny; nothing is shared before Allow
Join from the list of nets the app finds on your Wi-Fi, or type the host's short join code on a keypad
Changes made on one device appear on the other, and a step fired on one plays its animation on the other

behavior_changes.what: Joining a net replaces the net you have open with the host's (save it first to keep it)
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone who joins with unsaved work open

behavior_changes.what: The LAN connection is not encrypted. The host allows each person, and only local network addresses are accepted, but anyone on the same Wi-Fi could read the traffic
behavior_changes.who_is_affected: anyone sharing on a network they do not trust (a cafe, a campus)

behavior_changes.what: On a network, this device appears under its computer name (or Phone-xxx) instead of 'lafont'
